candidate_sources.README.md:
# Museum scan bundle preparation
The transport asynchronously fulfills false (pending) or true (ready). It can
report pending repeatedly. It does not issue retries itself. Retry callbacks are
scheduled for a later event turn and can be cancelled; no real-time interval is
part of this API. Render consumers never call back into this resource.

The foreground resource serves an opened document package. start, close, reopen
and snapshot are its public commands. The adjacent workspace job has its own
lifetime; its panel is only a display. Final owner disposal releases resources.
See the native resource classes and the workspace close implementation.

Business context: Museum scan bundle preparation. The package token identifies the prepared artifact;
foreground presentation and workspace preparation have separate owners.

checkpoints: A foreground start immediately initiates a check for the current token.
Each pending result permits another check through a cancellable callback on a later event turn; repeated pending results do not complete the package.
A ready result records the originating token once, clears loading and retry state, and publishes the result.
Close, reopen, restart, and disposal prevent obsolete responses and queued retries from changing the current foreground lifecycle.
Workspace preparation continues after its panel closes and releases resources on owner disposal.
forbidden_effects: Treating a pending status as package readiness or completion.
Allowing a stale response or retry to complete, publish, or initiate work for a replacement foreground lifecycle.
Introducing a real-time retry interval as an API requirement.
Making workspace panel closure cancel the independently owned workspace job.

lifecycle_identity: Resource generation identifies the current lifecycle; start, reopen, close of the foreground dialog, and disposal invalidate earlier work.
Each check captures its package token and generation; completion belongs to that captured token.
The foreground resource and workspace job have separate owners and lifetimes.

Keep the public commands, snapshot isolation of completed tokens, check counting, and existing readiness completion behavior while repairing foreground pending handling.
